edition: Health news digest – Tuesday, 17 November 2026 – Morning edition (LungDaily picks rebuilt 12:10 CET; the original file was not saved)

items.title: FDA rejects Summit's ivonescimab in previously treated EGFR-mutated NSCLC
items.summary: The FDA issued a complete response letter for ivonescimab plus chemotherapy in EGFR-mutated NSCLC after TKI therapy, because the phase 3 HARMONi trial did not show a statistically significant overall survival benefit.

items.title: FDA won't approve Summit and Akeso's ivonescimab
items.summary: Second report on the ivonescimab complete response letter; backup source in case the first page cannot be read.

items.title: Quantitative CT reveals air pollution-associated lung function changes (RSNA 2026 preview)
items.summary: A study to be presented at RSNA 2026 links sustained particulate-matter exposure to higher airway resistance and worse lung function on quantitative CT.
